name: Robert E. Ammons
tagline: Top rated Products Liability attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Robert E. Ammons is the founder and managing partner of The Ammons Law Firm in Houston, Texas. For over three decades he has represented consumers as a personal injury lawyer with his practice concentrated on tire and automotive defect cases involving catastrophic injury and wrongful death. He has served as lead counsel in over 430 cases that resulted in a verdict or settlement of $1 million or more.

Mr. Ammons obtained an $82.5 million verdict in Petrie v. Hanover, a record-setting result that earned a place in the Texas Verdicts Hall of Fame. He represents consumers exclusively and has litigated product liability cases against some of the largest companies in the automotive industry, including Michelin, Goodyear, Bridgestone/Firestone, General Motors, Ford, and Toyota, among others.

He is Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and Board Certified in Civil Law by the National Board of Trial Advocacy. Martindale-Hubbell has given him its AV Preeminent peer review rating and he is a member of the American Board of Trial Advocates. He has been included on the Texas Super Lawyers list every year from 2003 through 2023 and on the Texas Super Lawyers Top 100 from 2008 through 2023. Best Lawyers in America has recognized him in both Personal Injury Litigation and Product Liability Litigation for plaintiffs, and Lawdragon has named him to its 500 Leading Plaintiff Consumer Lawyers list.

Mr. Ammons graduated cum laude from Baylor University School of Law in 1988, where he served as an editor of the Baylor Law Review and was selected as a Briefing Attorney for the Texas Supreme Court following graduation. He is licensed in Texas, Florida, New York, Arizona, New Mexico, and Oklahoma, as well as several federal district courts.

In addition to his litigation work, Mr. Ammons has authored numerous articles for Trial Magazine and the Texas Bar Journal and edited the book Tire Defect Litigation. He serves as a director of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association and the Southern Trial Lawyers Association and sits on the board of the Attorney Information Exchange Group.
